dialogues.jp: 「……随分と本格的だな」
dialogues.en: "......It looks pretty professional."
dialogues.text: "......It looks pretty professional."

dialogues.jp:
音楽室に足を踏み入れると、まず、漆黒の闇が
出迎えてくれた。
dialogues.en:
When I stepped inside the music room, I was welcomed by
darkness.
dialogues.text:
When I stepped inside the music room, I was welcomed by
darkness.

dialogues.jp:
黒い垂れ幕と壁に挟まれた細い道が、もう一方
の扉に向かって伸びている。
dialogues.en:
A thin pathway between the black sheet and the wall led me
to another door.
dialogues.text:
A thin pathway between the black sheet and the wall led me
to another door.

dialogues.jp:
垂れ幕のほうには、ところどころに入口らしい
切込みが見える。
dialogues.en: There are several openings in the black sheet.
dialogues.text: There are several openings in the black sheet.

dialogues.jp: どうやら、いくつかの個室に分かれてるらしい。
dialogues.en: Apparently, it's divided into several different rooms.
dialogues.text: Apparently, it's divided into several different rooms.

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず、萌先輩の所に行ってみよう」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to see Moe-sempai first."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to see Moe-sempai first."

dialogues.jp:
入口で教えてもらった萌先輩の担当する部屋に
向かう。目が慣れるまでチト歩きにくいか……。
dialogues.en:
At the entrance, I asked where Moe's room wls located. I
walked toward the room, but it was difficult for me to walk
in the dark until I got used to it......
dialogues.text:
At the entrance, I asked where Moe's room wls located. I
walked toward the room, but it was difficult for me to walk
in the dark until I got used to it......

dialogues.jp: １番奥の部屋の前に立ち、そして――、
dialogues.en: I stood in front of the furthest room.......
dialogues.text: I stood in front of the furthest room.......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いらっしゃいませ」
dialogues.en: "Welcome."
dialogues.text: "Welcome."

dialogues.jp: 出迎えたのは、怪しげな占い師だった。
dialogues.en: A suspicious fortune-teller welcomed me.
dialogues.text: A suspicious fortune-teller welcomed me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。いらっしゃいませ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Welcome, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Welcome, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリと、見慣れた微笑みを浮かべる怪しい
占い師。
dialogues.en:
The suspicious fortune-teller gave me a familiar smile. The
witch in front of me was Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
The suspicious fortune-teller gave me a familiar smile. The
witch in front of me was Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: やはり、目の前のやまんばは萌先輩だった。
dialogues.en: "......What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "......What are you doing?"

dialogues.jp: 「……何してるんです？」
dialogues.en: I asked her, feeling dizzy looking at her strange look.
dialogues.text: I asked her, feeling dizzy looking at her strange look.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「木琴占いです」
dialogues.en: "I'm doing xylophone fortune-telling."
dialogues.text: "I'm doing xylophone fortune-telling."

dialogues.jp: 間髪いれずにこやかに答える萌先輩――。
dialogues.en: She calmly replied without pausing.
dialogues.text: She calmly replied without pausing.

dialogues.jp: （やっぱ、天才を超える存在か……？）
dialogues.en: (She's a genius in a way......)
dialogues.text: (She's a genius in a way......)

dialogues.jp: 「木琴……占い？」
dialogues.en: "Xylophone fortune-telling?"
dialogues.text: "Xylophone fortune-telling?"

dialogues.jp: かろうじて声が出た。
dialogues.en: I could barely speak.
dialogues.text: I could barely speak.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「木琴占いって｛・・・／あまり｝聞きませんけど、どう
　やって占うんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not very familiar with that style, but how exactly are
you going to read?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm not very familiar with that style, but how exactly are
you going to read?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「木琴を叩いて、音の違いで占うんです」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to hit the xylophone, and read according to the
difference of the sound."
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to hit the xylophone, and read according to the
difference of the sound."

dialogues.jp: そのまんま。
dialogues.en: That's pretty much what I'd expected.
dialogues.text: That's pretty much what I'd expected.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなに違う音って、でるもんなの？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by the difference of the sound?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by the difference of the sound?"

dialogues.jp:
いくら叩いても“ド”は“ド”、“レ”は“レ”
だと思うんだけど。
dialogues.en:
I think no matter how many times you hit it, 'C' will be 'C'
and 'D' will be 'D'......
dialogues.text:
I think no matter how many times you hit it, 'C' will be 'C'
and 'D' will be 'D'......

dialogues.jp: っていうか、そうじゃなきゃ楽器じゃない。
dialogues.en: In fact if not, it can't be an instrument!
dialogues.text: In fact if not, it can't be an instrument!

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。私……１度も同じ音を出したことって、
　ないんですよ……」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I've never hit the same sound before......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... I've never hit the same sound before......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「でも、みんなの役に立てるのは嬉しいです」
dialogues.en: "But I'm glad I can actually do something for others."
dialogues.text: "But I'm glad I can actually do something for others."

dialogues.jp:
どちらかというと、不幸中の幸いといった気が
するけど、萌先輩は嬉しそうに微笑んでいる。
dialogues.en: It doesn't sound great, but Moe-sempai's smiling joyfully.
dialogues.text: It doesn't sound great, but Moe-sempai's smiling joyfully.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それでは、そろそろ占いを始めますね」
dialogues.en: "Let me start telling your fortune now."
dialogues.text: "Let me start telling your fortune now."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩がマレットを構える。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai held the mallets in her hands.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai held the mallets in her hands.

dialogues.jp: 「そういや、なにを占ってくれるんです？」
dialogues.en: "What are you going to read for me?"
dialogues.text: "What are you going to read for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「運勢占いです」
dialogues.en: "I'll read your fortune."
dialogues.text: "I'll read your fortune."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「今日の運勢と５０年後、１００年後の運勢を
　占いますね」
dialogues.en:
"I'll read your fortune for 50 years from now, and 100 years
from now."
dialogues.text:
"I'll read your fortune for 50 years from now, and 100 years
from now."

dialogues.jp:
微笑みを浮かべ、木琴を叩き始める。占いの小
部屋に、個性的な音色が木霊する。
dialogues.en:
She smiled and started hitting the xylophone. Her unique
sound echoed inside of the small room.
dialogues.text:
She smiled and started hitting the xylophone. Her unique
sound echoed inside of the small room.

dialogues.jp: （１００年って……間隔長すぎ）
dialogues.en: (100 years from now...... That's too far from now.)
dialogues.text: (100 years from now...... That's too far from now.)

dialogues.jp: 普通、１年後とか１０年後だと思うんだけど。
dialogues.en:
A year from now or 10 years from now seems to make more
sense to me.
dialogues.text:
A year from now or 10 years from now seems to make more
sense to me.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、同じ音を聴かない。まさに神技……。
dialogues.en:
Just as she told me, I don't hear any identical sounds......
What a skill.
dialogues.text:
Just as she told me, I don't hear any identical sounds......
What a skill.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が木琴を叩く姿を見つめ、黙って結果の
出るのを待つ。
dialogues.en:
I stared at Moe-sempai playing the xylophone, and waited for
her answer.
dialogues.text:
I stared at Moe-sempai playing the xylophone, and waited for
her answer.

dialogues.jp: （不思議とドキドキするかな……）
dialogues.en: (I feel nervous for some reason......)
dialogues.text: (I feel nervous for some reason......)

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「は〜い、でました〜」
dialogues.en: "Okay, are you ready?"
dialogues.text: "Okay, are you ready?"

dialogues.jp: 木琴の音がやみ、先輩が顔をあげる。
dialogues.en:
The sound of the xylophone stopped, and Moe-sempai raised
her head up.
dialogues.text:
The sound of the xylophone stopped, and Moe-sempai raised
her head up.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「まず、今日の朝倉くんの運勢は……」
dialogues.en: "Your fortune for today is......"
dialogues.text: "Your fortune for today is......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「大凶です。できるだけ周囲に気を配って行動
　してください」
dialogues.en: "Very bad. Please be careful with your surroundings."
dialogues.text: "Very bad. Please be careful with your surroundings."

dialogues.jp:
とんでもないことを、にこやかに言わないでほ
しい。
dialogues.en:
How can she say such a terrible thing with a smile on her
face?
dialogues.text:
How can she say such a terrible thing with a smile on her
face?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「５０年後は大吉です。何をしても上手くいき
　そうな予感です。チャンスを頑張って活かし
　てください」
dialogues.en:
"You'll be very lucky 50 years from now. Everything will go
well for you. Please take advantage of your chances."
dialogues.text:
"You'll be very lucky 50 years from now. Everything will go
well for you. Please take advantage of your chances."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それで１００年後の運勢は……」
dialogues.en: "For 100 years from now......"
dialogues.text: "For 100 years from now......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ないですね」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't exist."
dialogues.text: "It doesn't exist."

dialogues.jp:
そりゃそうだろう。さすがに１００歳を超えて
生きてるなんてことは、そうあるもんじゃない。
dialogues.en:
That's what I thought. I don't think I'll live for more than
100 years.
dialogues.text:
That's what I thought. I don't think I'll live for more than
100 years.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「以上です。参考になりましたでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "That's all. Did it help you at all?"
dialogues.text: "That's all. Did it help you at all?"

dialogues.jp: 依然、やまんばスマイルを浮かべている萌先輩。
dialogues.en: She remained smiling as she asked me nicely.
dialogues.text: She remained smiling as she asked me nicely.

dialogues.jp:
「ええまあ。とりあえず、今日は気をつけてお
　きます」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I guess. I'll try and be careful today."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I guess. I'll try and be careful today."

dialogues.jp:
他のふたつに関しては、コメントのしようがな
い。
dialogues.en: I had nothing to say about the other two readings.
dialogues.text: I had nothing to say about the other two readings.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ俺、もう行きますんで。お仕事頑張っ
　て」
dialogues.en: "Well, I need to go now. Good luck with your job."
dialogues.text: "Well, I need to go now. Good luck with your job."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
占いもすんだし、萌先輩の変わった格好も見れ
たので、きりのいいところで退散しよう。
dialogues.en:
Now that the reading was over and I was able to see her
strange look, I decided to leave.
dialogues.text:
Now that the reading was over and I was able to see her
strange look, I decided to leave.

dialogues.jp: さてと……次はどこをまわろうかな。
dialogues.en: Now...... where to next?
dialogues.text: Now...... where to next?

dialogues.jp: ◆木琴占い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Xylophone fortune-telling◆
dialogues.text: ◆Xylophone fortune-telling◆

dialogues.jp: やまんば？
dialogues.en: A witch?
dialogues.text: A witch?

dialogues.jp:
いや、萌先輩である。木琴占いだそうだ。やっ
ぱ、天才を越えた存在なのか──！
dialogues.en:
No, it's Moe-sempai! She's doing xylophone fortune-telling.
I knew she was a genius in a way...!
dialogues.text:
No, it's Moe-sempai! She's doing xylophone fortune-telling.
I knew she was a genius in a way...!

dialogues.jp:
俺は、５０年後と１００年後の運勢を占っても
らったのだった。
dialogues.en:
She told my fortune for 50 years from now and 100 years from
now.
dialogues.text:
She told my fortune for 50 years from now and 100 years from
now.
